name: ai-goofish-monitor
description: 基于 Playwright 和AI实现的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控与智能分析系统，配备了功能完善的后台管理UI。帮助用户从闲鱼海量商品中，找到心仪产品。
one_liner: An AI tool that watches China's biggest secondhand marketplace around the clock and alerts you the moment an item matching exactly what you want shows up.
buyer: A secondhand-goods reseller or collector in China who wants to snipe underpriced or rare listings before anyone else sees them.
business_use_cases: A reseller sets it to watch for underpriced electronics or collectibles and gets an instant phone alert to message the seller before competitors do.
A parts hunter for a repair shop monitors for specific rare components (e.g. a discontinued phone screen model) and buys the moment one appears.
A sourcing agent for overseas buyers runs it against several product categories and resells the service of 'always finding it first' to clients abroad.

money_ideas.idea: Run it as a paid sourcing/sniping service for collectors or resellers who don't want to set it up themselves, charging a flat monthly fee per tracked category.
Charge a success fee (percentage of savings) each time it finds and secures an underpriced item for a client.

steal_this: Pick one high-demand, easy-to-verify item category (e.g. a specific discontinued gadget) and run this as a personal sourcing side-hustle this weekend, flipping what it finds.
